bio.text: Dan Cox is the Republican nominee for Governor of Maryland in the November 3, 2026 general election, on a joint ticket with Rob Krop.
He represented District 4 in the Maryland House of Delegates from January 2019 to January 2023.

He was born in Washington, D.C., has lived in Frederick County, Maryland, and earned a bachelor's degree from University of Maryland University College in 2002 and a J.D. from Regent University in 2006.
He has worked as an attorney with The Cox Law Center and as a high school teacher at Walkersville Christian Family Schools.
